value.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
value.text: In episode 13, after Master Mold turns on its makers, the X-Men capture Gyrich and force him to reveal where it is.

verdicts.why: Episode 13 shows Master Mold going rogue and the X-Men tracking down Gyrich for its location, but his flight with Trask to avoid prosecution is only established later (fandom cites it to the Courage episode, already covered by the episode 51 record), so that clause and the At large status are dropped.

Wikipedia: Lehnsherr and Ororo turn on En Sabah Nur and she is among the new X-Men recruits at the rebuilt school; X-Men Movies wiki: she turns after seeing her hero Mystique being choked by Apocalypse.
The Grandmaster melts David Richardson during the first rehearsal of the band he formed for a promo video, because Richardson plays wrong; it is not a video shoot.
Rogers never fights King Thor; his group infiltrates Thor's court and retrieves the Time Stone from Thor's scepter for Carter, which reveals him as the Forerunner.

value.text: In episode 133, Kora, Daisy's lost half-sister, joins Nathaniel Malick until Coulson takes her captive.

verdicts.why: Episode 133: Daisy learns Kora is her half-sister and Coulson takes Kora captive, so the record ends In custody; but nothing in the summaries shows her fighting for Malick there, so 'joins' is kept instead of 'fights for'.
Episode 135 Kora lets the agents escape and Nathaniel knocks her out; episode 136 she and May give the Chronicoms empathy and she revives Daisy, a side change the file lacks.

value.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
value.text: In episode 119, after his bomb plan fails, Sarge kills Pax. Mack overpowers him and he is locked up, where May enters his cell and seemingly kills him.

verdicts.why: Episode 119 confirms Pax's killing, Mack overpowering him and his imprisonment, but the episode's last event for him is May seemingly killing him in his cell, which the record must include; 'at the Lighthouse' is not stated in the source.
